notes.note: Reviewed telemetry API changes against mounted companion and incident-link routes, runtime mount, strict body/window validation, current operator checks and private link storage; reconciled proposal-only versus delivery/sync authority, requester-bound native consent and source/receiver restore-required behavior. Added actual incident/link inputs, receipts, replay/deletion and logical retention limits. Existing controlled consent/recovery tests passed; no hosted TLS, native shell, external issue existence/publishing or installed/release acceptance is claimed.

Reviewed telemetry-delivery/product-telemetry/usage-export and analytics-view declarations against their validators and consuming Core/SDK owners. Corrected usage-page-only authority wording, documented ProductTelemetryIncidents and createProductTelemetryIncidentDraft plus link receipts, and explained restore-required omission/refusal. Contract shapes and source review do not grant source/operator authority or qualify runtime/release delivery.

Reviewed changed companion lifecycle, product incident/link and private Insights API claims against SDK root/subpath exports and query-domain callers. Incident reads partition current scope/group/window; mutation uses once-only transport, matching receipt IDs and scoped invalidation. Private Insights inventory denial invalidates retained snapshots and prevents outage revival; foreground sync is bounded and explicit. No SDK API establishes installation, source permission, external publishing or native qualification.

Reviewed changed enrollment, encrypted source custody, explicit sync/index/saved Insights, companion incident handoff and private recovery explanations against current Core/broker/SDK/UI owners. Normal restore and in-place rollback publish fresh recovery provenance; approved/revoked and completed/cancelled snapshot controls passed across both paths, including interrupted rollback retry. Reconciled the remaining clone/mirror and installed-recovery limits. Product aggregates, local issue references, logical expiry and future physical pruning are distinguished from personal incident access, external issue publishing and deployed/native/release qualification.

Reviewed changed telemetry composition edges through runtime bootstrap/routes, private export and invalidation readers, source/recipient stores, saved-view/query callers and managed companion/broker owners. Added analytics activation and incident/link ownership; corrected obsolete durable-index/checkpoint limitation while preserving absence of background sync and real TLS/native qualification. Physical home/recovery binding is a negative fence, not verified canonical clone/mirror identity or permission. The map routes source owners and does not establish installed or released behavior.
